title: Chat artifact and decision card
canonical_summary: Hand the complete research/audit packet to the user as a chat artifact before presenting every item one at a time with plain name, one-sentence question, why, what you get, costs, options and optional recommendation. Full artifact remains openable.
gui_classification_reason: User-visible decision review flow and command interaction.
negative_constraints: No auto-approval, auto-denial or auto-submit on dismissal.
No agent may answer for the user.
Ask a question leaves the same decision pending and cannot consume or change its disposition.
No re-asking terminally answered decisions; retain pending and resolved identities on resume.
No colored status border bars or stripes; no emoji glyphs.
Approve authorizes planning only; PWIZ-010 Approve And Build remains separate.
No implementation, WorkNodes, NodeSeeds or governance seal.
One-at-a-time applies to this decision review profile only, not general questionnaire batches.
